body.description: Mailstrom: a rural roadside mailbox creature on its post like a single leg, the rounded tin box is its body, the door is a mouth with old letters peeking out, the red flag raised like an ear, dented and loyal. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
